intro.zh: 本手册介绍资料整理、检索和导出流程。粗体表示界面控件。本示例产品及所有参数均为虚构，仅用于验证模板。
intro.en: This manual covers organizing, finding, and exporting notes. Bold text identifies interface controls. This product and all parameters are fictional and exist only to test the template.

sources.description: Fictional source notes included with this example; not a real product.

gaps.reason: No certification information was supplied for the fictional product.

text.zh: 星笺资料整理台用于在示例工作区中整理演示资料。读者可按快速入门完成第一条记录，并在操作说明中了解检索和导出。
text.en: Starleaf Notes Studio organizes demonstration notes in a sample workspace. Follow Quick Start to create the first record, then use the operating instructions to find and export records.

text.zh: 本文覆盖记录管理流程。示例不提供设备接入、告警处理或认证声明。
text.en: This document covers record management. The example does not provide device connections, alarm handling, or certification claims.

text.zh: 使用已获得授权的示例账户打开本地演示工作区。账户由演示组织者提供，本文不包含固定口令。
text.en: Open the local demonstration workspace with an authorized sample account. The demonstration organizer supplies the account; this manual contains no fixed password.

text.zh: 确认页面显示虚构示例标记，再开始录入。
text.en: Confirm that the page displays the fictional-example label before entering data.

text.zh: 进入 **资料库（Library）**，选择 **新建记录（New record）**。
输入记录标题和说明，选择 **保存（Save）**。
text.en: Enter a record title and description, then select **Save**.

alt.zh: 虚构资料库包含新建记录按钮和演示记录列表。
alt.en: The fictional library contains a New record button and a list of demonstration records.

text.zh: 保存后确认记录出现在列表中。示例列表每 {{fact:interval}} 刷新一次。
text.en: After saving, confirm that the record appears in the list. The sample list refreshes every {{fact:interval}}.

text.zh: 本章介绍重复使用的查询、导出和状态检查步骤。
text.en: This chapter explains recurring search, export, and status-checking tasks.

text.zh: 在 **搜索（Search）** 框中输入标题关键词，然后选择匹配的记录。
text.en: Enter a title keyword in **Search**, then select a matching record.

text.zh: 选择 **导出（Export）** 以下载当前记录的文本副本。每次导出最多包含 {{fact:export_limit}} 条演示记录。
text.en: Choose **Export** to download a text copy of the current records. Each export contains at most {{fact:export_limit}} demonstration records.

rows.zh: 仅用于测试数据容量布局
rows.en: Used only to test a capacity-value layout

rows.zh: 用于验证两种语言的数值和单位一致
rows.en: Tests matching values and units across languages

text.zh: 若列表未显示预期记录，先检查当前筛选条件，再重新执行查询。若仍为空，联系演示组织者核对样例数据。
text.en: If an expected record is missing, check the current filter and search again. If the list remains empty, ask the demonstration organizer to verify the sample data.
